turns.question: On average, how many days did it take to hire a candidate, over everyone hired in October 2026?
turns.answer: On average, candidates hired in October 2026 took 6.08 days from applying to being hired (time to hire, in days, covering 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31). Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
